lines.en: I flutter along, stopping and starting.
Scale powder falls from my wings.
I fly a short way along the blooming.
My feet barely touch ground; I drift.

lines.zh: 时间对我没用，我慢慢飞。
lines.en: Time means nothing; I fly slowly.
A flower ahead; I circle it once.
My wings are heavy with dew.

lines.zh: 我跟着蜜蜂走，不抢它的。
lines.en: I follow the bees but take nothing theirs.
One gust and I am pushed along.

lines.zh: 幼虫时爬得慢，现在快些。
lines.en: As a larva I crawled; now I am quicker.
I settle on a grass tip and rise again.

lines.zh: 这条路我飞过一千遍了。
lines.en: I have flown this path a thousand times.

lines.zh: 我停在叶子上，收拢翅膀。
lines.en: I rest on a leaf with wings folded.
Candy in my pocket; still enough.
I count the patterns on my wings.
Eternity is long; I am in no hurry.
An ant crawls over my foot.
I shake scale powder into the sunlight.
I am not sleepy, but I close my eyes.
You cannot hear the sound of blooming.

lines.zh: 我哼一支没有结尾的调子。
lines.en: I hum a tune with no ending.

lines.zh: 幼虫的影子还在我背上。
lines.en: The shadow of my larval self stays on my back.
I lick sugar frosting off my fingertip.
Who sighed in the grass?

lines.zh: 我试着数清自己的年头。
lines.en: I try to count my own years.
My wings are dry now; that feels good.
I sit in the flower's heart, waiting for the dew to dry

lines.zh: 风把我的头发吹乱，我不理。
lines.en: The wind messes my hair; I let it
You have no scale powder on you.

lines.zh: 你看得见我，说明你有点眼力。
lines.en: You can see me, so you have some eye.
May I land on your shoulder?

lines.zh: 你的影子遮住了我的花。
lines.en: Your shadow has covered my flower.

lines.zh: 你在数我的翅膀？数不清的。
lines.en: Counting my wings? You will lose count.
I tilt my head; my wings tilt too.

lines.zh: 你的袖子有草汁的绿味。
lines.en: Your sleeve smells green with crushed grass.
Do not grab; you will ruin my powder.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛里有光，我喜欢。
lines.en: There is light in your eyes; I like it.
How long have we known each other? A year?

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候，我挪了一步。
lines.en: While you blinked, I moved a step.
Do you have any notion of eternity?

lines.zh: 我绕你半圈，看看你背后。
lines.en: I circle half around to see your back.
Do not rush; we have plenty of time.

lines.zh: 右边翅膀缺角，我打了个旋。
lines.en: A notch in my right wing spins me.
It hurts; my powder is falling off.
You have damaged my wing.
I fell to the ground and got up.
My candy fell out of my pocket.
For this, I will remember a hundred years.
Do not step; I am still moving.
My light has dimmed a little.
The pain passes; the wing will heal.
I have retreated into the flowers.
Is that sugar? I smell sweetness.
That bit of frosting in your palm.
I could abstain, but I want it.
Candy is far sweeter than nectar.
Trade candy for my name? Fine.
I am landing; hold still.
Something this sweet must be licked slowly.

lines.zh: 我翅膀抖了一下，是高兴。
lines.en: My wings twitched; that means joy.
Do you have more? I will not refuse.
The sweetness made me forget to leave.
You bumped me and my powder scattered.
We are light; a bump is nothing.

lines.zh: 你走路带风，把我吹偏了。
lines.en: Your stride blew me off course.

lines.zh: 我在你帽檐上停过一会儿。
lines.en: I rested on your hat brim a while.
Do not wave your arms; I get dizzy.
After the bump I landed on your cuff.
This close, I hear your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我的影子被你鞋底压住。
lines.en: Your sole is pressing down my shadow.
Let us both give way; neither is in a hurry.
I fly up and circle back to the same spot.
Wait for the flowers with me?

lines.zh: 我把最甜的那颗糖留给你。
lines.en: I saved the sweetest candy for you.

lines.zh: 永恒太长，一个人有点闷。
lines.en: Eternity is long; alone it is dull.
Let us count scale powder together.
You need not change, and neither do I.
Let us fly slower, side by side.

lines.zh: 幼虫会变成什么？我不知道。
lines.en: What does a larva become? I do not know.
Where are your wings? Never mind, I will carry you.
Spring will come again many times.
We do not need to hurry.
This candy goes into my pocket.
A petal will do for a bed.
I pick up an empty cocoon.

lines.zh: 这块木头压得我落回地面。
lines.en: This wood weighs me back to the ground.
I will plant this seed.
I fold the candy wrapper into a boat.
I dropped one; let me look.
I must inspect anything that shines.
Carrying it, I cannot fly high.
The candy is mine, and the wrapper too.

lines.zh: 有只虫子闯进了我的花。
lines.en: A bug has entered my flower.
That leaf is shaking; who is there?
A spider is spinning; I must avoid it.
Something touched my candy.
Its smell is sharp, not like flowers.
I see the web strands catching light.
That black shape is not a bird.
It waits for me to land; how mean.
I rise a little to get a look.
I look after this patch of flowers.
Who touched my cocoon?

lines.zh: 它的动作太慢了，破绽大。
lines.en: It moves too slowly; the opening is clear.

lines.zh: 我在它帽檐上方扇翅，不出声。
lines.en: I beat my wings above its hat, silent.
I sprinkle powder down to blind it.

lines.zh: 它看不见我，我看得见它。
lines.en: It cannot see me; I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 我贴着草叶挪到它背侧。
lines.en: I slide along the grass to its far side.
My wings stop; I hang in midair.
Its hand is rising; I back off.
I am reading the direction of the wind.
A little closer, and it is one strike.
It carries the smell of candy.
I am not rushed; eternity is long enough.
It has retreated into the shade.

lines.zh: 它握东西的手，我看得清。
lines.en: I can see the hand holding its weapon.
This strike must be precise, not heavy.
I smeared its eyes with scale powder.
A light tap and it withdrew.
One wingbeat and its hand went wide.
It swung; I tumbled once.
Afterward I land on a flower to breathe.
I do not want to dirty my wings.
Its sleeve is covered in my powder.
Powder in your face; take the hint.
I am backing off; do not follow.
Fighting is tiring; candy is better.
I climb out of the cocoon.
My wings are wet; let me dry them.

lines.zh: 这片草地有糖果的味道。
lines.en: This meadow smells of candy.
I have woken up once again.
The light is soft, good for flying.
I remember this place, or think I do.
Where there are flowers, there I am.
I fly one loop to learn the paths.
My scale powder is not quite dry.
Who planted flowers beside me?
Eternity begins again today.

lines.zh: 我抖抖翅膀，落下一点粉。
lines.en: I flutter and a little powder falls.
Any new friends about?
Slowly now; I am not in a hurry.
The edge of my wing is scorched.
Falling from that height left me dizzy.
Water soaks my powder and I sink.
The shockwave tossed me into the ferns.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过了我的翅膀。
lines.en: Something passed through my wing.
This light is brighter than mine, and it stings.
No candy left; my wings feel weak.
The thunder shook powder off me.
Below is nothing; I keep falling.
